description: Objective checks on a finished episode, run before publishing. Not judgement — every check is a measurement against a declared threshold, which is what makes it safe to gate on automatically. The verdict gates publication; warnings are recorded and do not block, so a slightly short script ships while placeholder images do not. maxItems raised 40 -> 64: retention_qa's real check count is already 11 script-quality dimensions + 17 dialogue-evidence checks + 18 base/hybrid checks = 46, and PR #164's hybrid checks (explanation_model_coverage, character_cut_in_restraint, ai_shot_semantics, visual_style_continuity, visual_reset_cadence, opening_visual_hook, bookend_entity_continuity, closing_visible_payoff, and others) are exactly what pushed a genuine production run over the old 40 cap.

verdict.description: fail when any check failed. The publish gate reads exactly this field.

message.description: Written for whoever reads it at 7am wondering why nothing published.

measured.description: The value the check measured, when it is numeric. Kept numeric so thresholds can be compared and trended rather than parsed out of prose.

threshold.description: The bound it was measured against.
